The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3dae0156982e5d20), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 59-60. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Fix a nonnegative smooth radial bump ρ, supported in the unit disk, with integral one, and fix a sufficiently small θ > 0. For z ∈ D write d(z) = dist(z, ∂D) and ρz(u) = (θd(z))−2 ρ  u − z θd(z)  , Yz = H(ρz), where H is any subsequential distributional and moment limit of the true fields. For every 1 ≤ p < ∞, sup z∈D ∥Yz∥p ≤ Cp,θ,D,ρ. (6.11) In particular this bound is uniform when z approaches any point of a fixed compact boundary arc. Let p0 ∈ ∂D and let F be a product of a fixed number of smooth averages supported a positive distance from p0. The averages may be fixed in the interior, or may be of the same comparable-depth form with centers approaching fixed boundary points distinct from p0. Then, jointly in those allowed approaches, E[YzF] −→ 0 (z −→ p0). (6.12) The same statement holds for finite linear combinations of these products. If p1, . . . , pm are distinct fixed boundary points and zi → pi, then the reference average Zm = m−1 Pm i=1 Yzi satisfies lim sup zi→pi ∥Zm∥2 ≤ Cm−1/2 , sup m sup z1,...,zm ∥Zm∥p ≤ Cp. (6.13) 59 In the first assertion m and its distinct boundary points are fixed before taking the depth limits. Subsequently m → ∞ makes these references tend to zero in every finite Lp.
